Cenex

Prizes Worth : INR 25000



Registration deadline - 25th January 2024

Abstract submission deadline - 31st January 2024

Proof of Project submission deadline - 1st March 2024

*Sign Up first in order to register and first Register in order to submit Abstract

Abstract description:

An abstract is a concise version of your model focusing on the essentials of a more significant idea. It should be sufficient for reviewers to recognize the nature and significance of your model and the fairness of your approach.

The following elements must be included in the abstract:

  • Team Name
  • Names of all the team members.
  • Specific details of approach to be used in the model's construction.

Note: Abstract should be in .pdf format

Submission :

  • Submission has to be made by making changes in the template attached for abstract submission.
  • You are expected to do the necessary changes in the template and submit it in pdf format. For making changes in template first make a copy of the google doc and then do the changes.
  • Only one member from each group is required to do the submission.
  • Attach the photographs of your model as mentioned above in a different pdf and then combine both the pdfs into one for the final abstract submission.
  • Last date for abstract submission is 31st Jan’2024 .

Register

Civil Engineering National Exhibition, CENEX which provides a unique opportunity to all civil engineering students across India by facilitating them to showcase their research projects incorporating new technology via different models, prototypes, simulation models or samples in front of eminent professors and professionals. The cardinal aim of this event is to show light on technological advancements by the youth of this country and provide an opportunity to showcase their innovations on a wider platform.

  • Registration deadline : 10th January 2024
  • Abstract submission deadline : 31st January 2024
  • Abstract shortlist
  • Proof of Project submission deadline : 1st March 2024
  • Prizes worth INR 25,000 will be awarded to the top winner of the cenex
  • All the participants will get access to all the events and competitions at discounted prices in the main event, which will be held in mid March
  • Top participants will be featured on our official social media account and receive a certificate of excellence
  • Goodies awaiting for all participants coming for finals
  • Team Aakaar, IIT Bombay, has the final decision-making authority.
  • Aakaar, IIT Bombay reserves the right to disqualify any participant if found using any unfair means.
  • Aakaar, IIT Bombay reserves the right to change any or all of the above rules as they deem fit. Changes in rules, if any, will be notified to the registered participantsthrough the mail.
  • Aakaar, IIT Bombay, will hold no responsibility for any late, lost, or discredited entries.
  • Selected teams must submit a non-refundable fee of Rs.250 per team to present their models/projects/prototypes at Aakaar, IIT Bombay.
  • All modes of official communication will be through Aakaar E-mail.
  • Prizes will be given during the Main Event of Aakaar, IIT Bombay.
